title: Obenseuer
summary: Experimental Obenseuer HDR10 support: HDR10/PQ swapchain, RenoDRT upgrade of the game's graded SDR output, and display white calibration.
notes: In development: validated gameplay SDR/HDR10 pair; title and gameplay shader paths covered.
The swapchain stays HDR10 for both content modes; SDR content is left in SDR range, matching the generic Unity addon.
The Linux build requires clang-cl with the Microsoft ABI; MinGW's structure-return ABI is incompatible with ReShade. Load only this game addon during validation.
